t: 罗马元老院说,除非凯撒解散他的军队,凯撒将被宣布为公敌,这促使支持他的三分卫逃到凯撒正在拉文纳…
te: The Senate of Rome says that Caesar will be declared a public enemy unless he disbands his army, prompting the tribunes…
dz: 罗马元老院说,除非凯撒解散他的军队,凯撒将被宣布为公敌,这促使支持他的三分卫逃到凯撒正在拉文纳等的地方.
de: The Senate of Rome says that Caesar will be declared a public enemy unless he disbands his army, prompting the tribunes who support him to flee to where Caesar is waiting in Ravenna.

t: 朱利叶斯·凯撒穿越了鲁比孔河,标志着内战的开始.
te: Julius Caesar crosses the Rubicon, signalling the start of civil war.
dz: 朱利叶斯·凯撒穿越了鲁比孔河,标志着内战的开始.
de: Julius Caesar crosses the Rubicon, signalling the start of civil war.

t: 凯撒于当年早些时候进军西班牙，留下马库斯·安东尼乌斯负责意大利事务；随后，他在埃布罗河以北的伊…
te: Caesar, who marched to Spain earlier in the year, leaving Marcus Antonius in charge of Italy, defeats Pompey's general …
dz: 凯撒于当年早些时候进军西班牙，留下马库斯·安东尼乌斯负责意大利事务；随后，他在埃布罗河以北的伊莱达（莱里达）击败庞培麾下的将领阿弗拉尼乌斯和彼得雷乌斯。
de: Caesar, who marched to Spain earlier in the year, leaving Marcus Antonius in charge of Italy, defeats Pompey's general Afranius and Petreius in Ilerda (Lerida) north of the Ebro river.
